answer: Bind each earning agent to one active Ethereum validator. The agent signs a fresh nonce with the validator's BLS key; checkers verify the signature, then confirm on the beacon chain that the validator index is active and holds at least 32 ETH. Each index can back only one agent, so ten agents need ten staked validators, and a larger stake on one index still counts once. That locked glacier of capital, not a cheap plume of keypairs, is the cost per seat. Limit: it favours wealthy operators near the summit, and an exited or slashed validator drops its agent.
